hard_gates: No connectivity-changing conformer may enter the aligned ranking.
Every final conformer must have an atom-mapped parent lineage with explicit source conformer id, atom-index mapping, and non-empty parent artifact ids.
Ranking statistics may only use conformers whose connectivity and explicit atom-index mapping were validated before alignment.
Significant imaginary frequencies must be reported and handled before population analysis.
GoodVibes must be executed through the managed GoodVibes Action on completed quantum output files. Python-only thermochemistry or Boltzmann population code is not an acceptable substitute.
budget_rule: The agent may limit ORCA refinement, but must justify the rule and estimate missed population.
